prompts.brazier: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: isolated full-body dungeon fixture for UNDERCROFT, forgotten 1993 VGA first-person dungeon crawler. Primary request: one COLD standing abbey brazier, a broad shallow black iron bowl mounted on a squat thick stem and three sturdy low feet. Eye-level front view with a little of the bowl's inside visible. Bowl occupies top third; heavy sturdy silhouette, modest height, not a tall dining table or a lamp. Inside, a dark bed of charcoal and a few pale ash chunks, absolutely NO flame or glow. A simple forged bronze bell emblem on the bowl front ties it to an abandoned abbey; forged iron rings, quiet rusty edges, broad planes. Hand-painted early-1990s fantasy game sprite, clean silhouette, readable large shapes, muted dark steel, ash-grey edge highlights, warm rust and bronze trim, navy deepest shadows. Intended reduction to 64 pixels high and shared 31-colour palette. Full object centered with generous empty space ABOVE the bowl for later native-pixel flames; all feet and bowl in frame, transparent background. No floor, no cast shadow plane, no scenery, no text, no watermark, no UI, no modern shiny 3D.
prompts.reed_torch: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: isolated world pickup sprite for UNDERCROFT painted 1993 VGA dungeon crawler. Primary request: ONE UNLIT reed torch, hand-bound from several stiff pale dried reeds, wrapped tightly with three dark brown cord bindings near the head and a worn leather grip lower down. Clearly a bundle of reeds with a broad rough fibrous torch head, not a modern stick or medieval steel sconce. Full object leans very slightly to viewer right, lower end at bottom centre; front orthographic item illustration. The bundle head occupies the upper third; broad simple material planes readable at 48 pixels tall and 16-pixel icon scale. Absolutely no flame, glow, smoke, sparks, ground, shadow plane or scenery. Polished hand-painted early-1990s fantasy game inventory/world sprite, parchment reeds and ochre stems, bronze-brown bindings, navy dark crevices, large quiet highlights, transparent background. Generous transparent space above and beside head for later pixel fire. Entire item visible with margin. No labels, no text, no watermark, no UI, no modern 3D.
prompts.dawn_seal: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: exquisite objective object sprite for UNDERCROFT, forgotten 1993 VGA first-person dungeon crawler. Primary request: the abbey's lost DAWN SEAL displayed upright on a low carved stone pedestal. This should be the most beautiful small object in an otherwise humble dark dungeon. The Seal is a large round ancient bronze-and-gold sun disc, one clear circular teal enamel ring around a luminous warm ivory inner sun, eight broad elegant sun rays engraved in the outer rim, small old hand-chased details subordinate to large readable forms. Its lower rim rests in a small bronze cradle on the pedestal; no floating medallion. Inside the sun is a single elegant upward dawn arch, simple large symbol. Softly lit from within, subdued warm gold light, bright bone/ivory core and rich teal enamel, deep blue recesses, warm worn metal; no white bloom hiding the design. Pedestal is short and wide, beautifully carved but quiet blue-grey abbey limestone with one teal inlaid band, broad trapezoidal foot flush on the floor, no spindly table legs. Head-on eye-level view, show very little of the pedestal top. Entire disc and pedestal centered with generous transparent margins, clear round-disc-over-low-plinth silhouette. Large polished painterly facets suitable for reduction to 64,40,24 pixels with 31 shared colours. A touch of 1993 fantasy box-art magic, genuinely aged hand-painted material, no modern glossy 3D, no gem cluster, no skulls, no extra candles, no extraneous props. Real transparent background, no floor, no scenery, no drop shadow plane, no text, watermark or UI.
prompts.ash_hound_ember: Use case: lighting-weather. Edit target: the existing horizontal THREE-pose Ash Hound source sheet. Change ONLY its lighting and palette visibility. Preserve exactly the three existing poses and layout: standing idle left, deeply flattened wide lunge crouch middle, knocked-back forelegs-up recoil right. Preserve dog proportions, head direction, stone/ash fur material, all limbs, tails, spacing, silhouette and feet baselines. Do not redesign, reposition or crop any animal. Add a clearly readable warm EMBER RIM LIGHT tracing the ear tips, top of muzzle, front shoulders and outer legs of EACH pose, plus broad glowing amber/orange cracks in shoulder, chest and back. Lift the ash-grey body planes to a lighter cool ash grey so all three silhouettes remain readable at 24 px against very dark blue-black dungeon walls. Keep dark recesses and a predominantly ash-grey body: warm light belongs to the edges, eyes and cracks, never a solid orange dog. Use broad connected rim highlights and glowing fissure clusters, no noisy scattered sparks, no decorative particles, no opaque halo or floor shadows. Same hand-painted early-1990s VGA fantasy style, warm bronze/amber/bone highlights and muted blue-grey ash planes, no neon red. Maintain original transparent background and full horizontal sheet framing. No text, labels, dividers, UI or watermark.
